meaning: 职业运动员，以运动为生
usageNote: 名词短语！说那些靠打球踢球赚钱的大咖，普通爱好者可不算哦～

examples.en: Professional athletes train for hours every day to stay competitive.
examples.zh: 职业运动员每天训练数小时以保持竞争力。

examples.en: Many professional athletes struggle with injuries throughout their careers.
examples.zh: 许多职业运动员在整个职业生涯中都要与伤病抗争。
